COMMERCE COLLEGE, KOKRAJHAR
                                   NOTICE
                                  Dt. 04-11-2025

       For PG (M.Com.) 1st Semester (Arrear/Betterment and last
   chance/mercy) and 3rd Semester (Regular / Arrear/ Betterment and
               Arrear) Examination, 2025 form fill up.
It is hereby informed that the examination form fill-up process for the students of
PG (M.Com.) 1st Semester (Arrear/Betterment and last chance/mercy)
and 3rd Semester (Regular / Arrear/ Betterment and Arrear)
Examination, 2025 form fill up will be done through online system and submit
to college office dates as mentioned below:

 IMPORTANT DATES
    Date of Portal Active                                       - 01/11/2025
    Date of Online form Submission at College                   - 10/11/2025

 Necessary documents to be submitted along with the Fees;
      i)     Photo Copy of Admit Card of Last Examination
      ii)    Photo copy of Marksheet of Last/Arrear Examination

                                  Fees Structure
                                     1st Semester                 3rd Semester
  Sl. No.     Particulars                     Arrear/                    Arrear/
                                 Regular                      Regular
                                            Betterment                  Betterment
    1.      Examination Fee         -         1250/-           1100/-     1400/-
    2.      Centre Fee              -          500/-           500/-       500/-
    3.      Misc.                   -          200/-           200/-       200/-
                                              1950/-           1800/-     2100/-

 N.B.: 1) Link for Examination form fill up portal - https://bodolanduniversity.qwertcorp.in
       2) If students pay Examination Fees Online mode then only Centre and Misc.
          Fee to paid in college.




                                                                 Principal i/c,
                                                           Commerce College, Kokrajhar
